issues.message: Not yet placed by a builder GameTest: stone_brick_wall, iron_bars, red_wall_banner.

notes.detail: Capped at 1: L2 adds banners, iron-bar windows, lamp posts and barrels/hay at the back, but that is props; the promised portcullis is one row of iron bars at (6..8,3,4) that does not show in any view.
notes.levels: Tells apart from L1 by the red banners on the front, but no new feature or job is clearly visible.
notes.materials: White terracotta face on the gate-room back wall is still there.
notes.roof: Same bare crenellated tops as L1; two barrels and lanterns on the tops help a little.

visual.summary: L1 plus red banners on both towers and over the gate, iron bars in the slits, lamp posts and stores at the back; the portcullis is only a single row of bars.
problems: Portcullis: a single row of iron_bars at (6,3,4),(7,3,4),(8,3,4) is invisible; make it a real portcullis (2-3 rows of bars or a dark oak/iron grid hanging in the front arch at z 3), so L2 adds a clearly visible new feature.
Still no gate leaves at the back (z 7..8); consider spruce doors/fence gates as the gate itself.
White_terracotta at (6,6,7) and (8,6,7) on the dark oak gate-room back wall reads as a face; swap it.
Reachability: 241 of 242 standing places reached (only the corner (10,5,2)). Fine.
